audit.why: 50.96% over 12370 games; Ahri holds levels 1-6 on range (Q 970 vs Chain Lash 775) and loses the two-item stage to Hijack plus Kingslayer sustain. Difficulty 5.5/10 matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes never state Sylas's real cooldown spikes: Hijack drops 80 -> 55 -> 30s, Kingslayer 12s -> 6s, Abscond/Abduct 13s -> 9s.
audit.why: The whole matchup is gated on how often his single gap-closer and his heal come back.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers folded into breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability interactions were stated only as the compound name 'Abscond / Abduct' with no mechanics. Charm explicitly 'instantly stops movement abilities' — that is the decisive interaction against a champion whose only approach is a dash plus a recast pull.
audit.why: Ahri E stops movement abilities, so it cancels Abscond mid-dash and denies the Abduct recast; Sylas is then a 400-range melee with Chain Lash (775) as his only reach.
audit.corrected: Named the interaction in tradeGood, carry, dosFull[1..2], dontsFull[2], cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns was a template with no numbers (packet defect: sequencingCues 0).
No anti-heal timing despite Kingslayer sustain.
Level chart disagreed across layers: every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while win[0..5] read 'Ahri' and win[6] 'Sylas'.
audit.why: Two layers rendering different answers to 'who wins Level 1'. packet.levelChart agrees with win[].

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Abducting onto you, healing the trade back with Kingslayer, and cashing your own ultimate through Hijack.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Spirit Rush (last dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct is his only gap-closer — 13s at rank 1, 9s maxed. Step up the moment he spends the dash forward. - Kingslayer heals him off you and hits a 6s cooldown by rank 5, so buy anti-heal before extended trades. - Keep your last Spirit Rush dash for his Abduct recast.

edits.before: If Sylas gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Abscond / Abduct extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q clears and stay relevant through charm picks.
edits.after: If Sylas gets a kill his Kingslayer heal scales with the AP he buys — hold outside 400 range so Abduct is his only way in. Two kills: Q-farm, save charm for his dash, pick elsewhere.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Charm him mid-Abscond and he is a melee with no exit; your dashes make angles his 400-range kit can't reach.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt the map: shove with Q, dash-flank every river, and charm-pick Sylas's teammates until the lane lead is a game lead.
edits.after: Ahead, shove with Q and roam: his chase is a 400-range dash, so he can't follow, and picks you take are ults Hijack never copies.

edits.before: Q through his last-hit so both hits land, W if he eats the return, and walk — repeat until the charm window is lethal instead of optimistic.
edits.after: Q through his last-hit so both hits land, W the return, and step back outside 400 — Chain Lash is his only ranged answer and it telegraphs its explosion.

edits.before: Q through his last-hit so both hits land, W if he eats the return, and walk — repeat until the charm window is lethal instead of optimistic.
edits.after: Sylas answers Spirit Rush with the Abduct recast pull — spend two dashes for the charm angle and bank the third for the moment his chains land.

edits.before: Sylas spends Abscond / Abduct early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: His Chain Lash reaches 775, your orb 970 — farm from the back and he must dash in to answer.

edits.before: Charming on cooldown for chip damage and then facing his real engage with nothing — the charm is the matchup, not the poke.
edits.after: Charm down is Sylas's window — 12 seconds with no answer to Abduct, and he only needs to land one to be on top of you.

notes: Charm's 'instantly stops movement abilities' is the load-bearing interaction and was absent from every field. Level chart disagreed across layers on all seven rows (phases[].side all 'Skill' vs win[] Ahri/Sylas); fixed on the full layer only because win[] already matches packet.levelChart. Did not assert Hijack spell-shield/QSS behaviour, cast-time or whether charm can interrupt the Hijack channel — not in the kit text.
